import sys
import math

def get_abs(x):
    return -x if x < 0 else x

def mod_pow(base, exp, modulus):
    if exp <= 0:
        return 1
    half_pow = mod_pow(base, exp // 2, modulus)
    half_pow = (half_pow * half_pow) % modulus
    return (half_pow * base) % modulus if (exp & 1) else half_pow

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    total_N = int(input[0])
    total_M = int(input[1])
    modulus = int(input[2])

    fact = [1] * (total_N + 1)
    inv_fact = [1] * (total_N + 1)

    for i in range(1, total_N + 1):
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % modulus
        inv_fact[i] = inv_fact[i - 1] * mod_pow(i, modulus - 2, modulus) % modulus

    count_arr = [0] * (total_M + 1)
    sum_arr = [0] * (total_M + 1)
    count_arr[0] = 1

    for m in range(1, total_M + 1):
        for k in range(m):
            left_c = count_arr[k] * inv_fact[k] % modulus
            right_c = count_arr[m - 1 - k] * inv_fact[m - 1 - k] % modulus
            left_s = sum_arr[k] * inv_fact[k] % modulus
            right_s = sum_arr[m - 1 - k] * inv_fact[m - 1 - k] % modulus
            count_arr[m] = (count_arr[m] + left_c * right_c % modulus * (m + 1)) % modulus
            sum_arr[m] = (sum_arr[m] + (left_s * right_s + left_c * right_s + left_s * right_c) % modulus * (m + 1)) % modulus
            sum_arr[m] = (sum_arr[m] + left_c * right_c % modulus * (k * (k + 1) + (m - k) * (m - k - 1)) // 2) % modulus
        count_arr[m] = count_arr[m] * fact[m - 1] % modulus
        sum_arr[m] = sum_arr[m] * fact[m - 1] % modulus

    N = total_N
    M = total_M

    count_result = [[0] * (M + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    sum_result = [[0] * (M + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    count_result[0][0] = 1

    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        for j in range(0, min(i, M) + 1):
            count_result[i][j] = count_result[i - 1][j]
            sum_result[i][j] = sum_result[i - 1][j]
            if j == i:
                count_result[i][j] = (count_result[i][j] + count_arr[i] * inv_fact[i]) % modulus
                sum_result[i][j] = (sum_result[i][j] + sum_arr[i] * inv_fact[i]) % modulus
            for k in range(1, min(j, i - 1) + 1):
                c = count_arr[k] * inv_fact[k] % modulus
                s = sum_arr[k] * inv_fact[k] % modulus
                count_result[i][j] = (count_result[i][j] + count_result[i - 1 - k][j - k] * c) % modulus
                sum_result[i][j] = (sum_result[i][j] + (sum_result[i - 1 - k][j - k] * c + count_result[i - 1 - k][j - k] * s)) % modulus
            count_result[i][j] %= modulus
            sum_result[i][j] %= modulus

    final_answer = sum_result[N][M] * fact[M] % modulus
    print(final_answer)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
